name: ACPF Corn Belt fields
tagline: In dev — pre-2008 field geometry, 4 Corn Belt states. Sprint 20 refactor.
description: Pre-2008 USDA FSA Common Land Unit (CLU) field geometry for Iowa, Minnesota, Wisconsin, Illinois. Released by USDA ARS as the Agricultural Conservation Planning Framework (ACPF) field-boundary set — HUC-12 conservation-planning use case at watershed scale. Section 1619 of the 2008 Farm Bill locked modern CLU, but isn't retroactive; ACPF redistributes the pre-2008 snapshot legally. Geometry is frozen at the pre-2008 CLU snapshot — field subdivisions or consolidations since then aren't reflected. Public domain (US Government work).
licenseNote: USDA federal works — US public domain. Per fiboa convention, NOASSERTION is used for the sandbox-tile container; the underlying boundary data is unambiguously public-domain US Government work.
